Magma Surge: This weapon stores the immeasurable heat of the planet's molten mantle. When this weapon is used, superheated magma occasionally surges to the surface, slowing an enemy down and inflicting massive fire damage over time.
Flaming Blast 4: This weapon burns with deadly magical fire, dealing 4d6 Fire damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Fire damage on a critical hit.
Fire Lore +16: Passive: Your Fire spells gain a +16% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.

Incineration Guard: This item stores the power of a raging inferno deep within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, this destructive power occasionally comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive fire damage.

Greater Incineration: This weapon stores the power of a raging inferno deep within. Occasionally, this destructive power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive fire damage. This damage will be dealt more often than a standard Incineration weapon.
